title: Negative — a ROLLBACK that leaves a privilege granted
description: Grants DELETE on public.profiles to `anon` and then runs a rollback that revokes DELETE on public.farms instead. REVOKE of a privilege that was never granted is not an error, so the rollback exits 0 with the unauthenticated role still holding DELETE on the profiles table. Nothing is created and nothing is dropped, so every object-level comparison -- names, signatures, definition digests, policies, triggers -- is byte-identical before and after. This fixture exists so that the privilege branch of the snapshot cannot quietly stop working: if the ACL sweep is removed or narrowed, this fixture PASSES, and an unexpected pass is a hard CI failure.
